key_insight: Biomarker Convert is a computational method that harmonizes plasma pTau217 measurements across immunoassay and mass spectrometry platforms so results can be directly compared.
clinical_relevance: By standardizing pTau217 readouts, the tool could simplify biomarker screening and reduce the need for Aβ PET scans when identifying participants for Alzheimer’s research trials.
method: Measured plasma pTau217 across up to three assay platforms in three cohorts
Built cross-platform conversion equations using Deming regression
Tested robustness in independent research cohorts and modeled trial-screening impact
evidence_signal: Across platforms, pTau217 showed similarly strong Aβ-positive prediction (AUC 0.929-0.952), and the screening model suggested >60% fewer Aβ PET scans could be needed.
watch_item: Conversion equations need careful validation before routine use because assay performance, cohort makeup, and platform calibration can vary across sites.
paper_title: Biomarker Convert: a novel approach to transform plasma pTau217 results across immunoassay and mass spectrometry analytical platforms
